responsibility: Defines rs6000-specific machine modes beyond the generic GCC set, especially the three 128-bit floating-point modes for IBM long double, explicit IEEE quad, and configurable long double, plus PowerPC condition-code modes and several vector, partial-integer, and opaque MMA-related modes. It is the target mode-definition file from which GCC derives the backend’s mode tables and semantics for PowerPC-specific data representations.
same_name_distinction: This is the mode-definition source in the rs6000-modes pair: it enumerates the actual target machine modes and condition-code/vector/opaque mode entries, while rs6000-modes.h just supplies supporting precision constants used by those definitions.
